18.title: Report
18.content:
<align="left">Experimental Record-Sea Monster
Current Loss: 58 Units
Remaining Count: 96 Units
Notice: Among the 58 sea monsters lost, 30 had died before the experiment.
Probable Causes: Dehydration and Starvation.
Proposal: Supply a small amount of food and water at the detention site to ensure the survival of the test subjects until the experiment begins.

現在の消費量：58体
残り：96体
注意：消費した58体のうち、30体は実験前に死亡。
恐らく脱水と飢餓が原因だと思われる。
改善案：収容時に少量の水と食料を与え、実験開始まで生存させる。
